baseImages.name: CentOS Stream 9
baseImages.description: CentOS Stream 9 - Continuously delivered Linux distribution

baseImages.name: CentOS Stream 10
baseImages.description: CentOS Stream 10 - Latest continuously delivered Linux distribution

examples.name: Minimal
examples.description: Minimal base image with root password for testing
examples.containerfile:
# Minimal bootc image with root login enabled
# WARNING: This is for testing only - do not use in production!
RUN echo "root:root" | chpasswd

examples.name: Apache Web Server
examples.containerfile:
# Install and configure Apache web server RUN dnf -y install httpd && \ systemctl enable httpd && \ mv /var/www /usr/share/www && \ sed -ie 's,/var/www,/usr/share/www,' /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf && \ rm /usr/share/httpd/noindex -rf && \ echo '

Hello from Bootc!

' > /usr/share/www/html/index.html EXPOSE 80

examples.name: Tailscale VPN
examples.description: Install Tailscale VPN agent for secure networking
examples.containerfile:
# Install Tailscale VPN
# Note: After boot, run 'tailscale up' to authenticate
RUN dnf config-manager --add-repo https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable/centos/9/tailscale.repo && \
    dnf -y install tailscale && \
    dnf clean all && \
    ln -s ../tailscaled.service /usr/lib/systemd/system/default.target.wants

examples.name: QEMU Guest Agent
examples.description: Install QEMU guest agent for VM management
examples.containerfile:
# Install QEMU guest agent for better VM integration
RUN dnf -y install qemu-guest-agent && \
    dnf clean all && \
    systemctl enable qemu-guest-agent

examples.name: VMware Tools
examples.containerfile:
# Install VMware Tools for VMware/vSphere compatibility
RUN dnf -y install open-vm-tools && \
    dnf clean all && \
    systemctl enable vmtoolsd.service

examples.name: Cloud-Init
examples.description: Enable cloud-init for AWS, KubeVirt, and other cloud platforms
examples.containerfile:
# Install cloud-init for cloud deployments (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.)
RUN dnf -y install cloud-init && \
    ln -s ../cloud-init.target /usr/lib/systemd/system/default.target.wants && \
    rm -rf /var/{cache,log} /var/lib/{dnf,rhsm}

examples.name: Docker Engine
examples.description: Install Docker CE with compose and buildx plugins
examples.containerfile:
# Install Docker CE with compose and buildx
# See: https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/centos/
RUN dnf install -y yum-utils && \
    dnf config-manager --add-repo https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo && \
    dnf install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin && \
    dnf clean all && \
    systemctl enable docker

examples.name: WiFi Support
examples.containerfile:
# Install WiFi and wireless networking support
RUN dnf -y install NetworkManager-wifi NetworkManager-wwan wpa_supplicant wireless-regdb && \
    dnf clean all

examples.name: Development Tools
examples.description: Common development tools (git, vim, tmux, etc.)
examples.containerfile:
# Install common development tools
RUN dnf -y install git vim tmux htop curl wget make gcc && \
    dnf clean all

examples.name: Cockpit Web Console
examples.containerfile:
# Install Cockpit web console for server management
RUN dnf -y install cockpit cockpit-storaged cockpit-podman && \
    dnf clean all && \
    systemctl enable cockpit.socket

EXPOSE 9090

examples.name: SSH Key Authentication
examples.description: Configure SSH with your public key
examples.containerfile:
# Configure SSH key authentication
# Replace the key below with your actual public key
RUN mkdir -p /root/.ssh && \
    echo 'ssh-ed25519 YOUR_PUBLIC_KEY_HERE user@host' >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys && \
    chmod 700 /root/.ssh && \
    chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys

examples.name: Nginx Web Server
examples.containerfile:
# Install and configure Nginx web server RUN dnf -y install nginx && \ systemctl enable nginx && \ echo '

Hello from Bootc!

' > /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html EXPOSE 80

examples.name: Podman Container Engine
examples.containerfile:
# Install Podman container engine
RUN dnf -y install podman podman-compose && \
    dnf clean all
